topic: Bulk update of user login email handles after customer email domain migration
symptom_pattern: Customer's IT team is migrating users to a new email domain, which also affects SSO login, so the Datadog login email (handle) of the affected users must be changed at a scheduled time. The customer supplied CSV files of users and asked Support to apply the change.
root_cause: Not a fault. The customer's email domain migration changes SSO login emails, so the Datadog user handles had to be updated to match. This required Support to update the handles.
resolution_path: Customer asked for the handle update to be scheduled for a specific time and sent a CSV of affected users
Customer corrected the request before it was applied: one user was to be excluded and another was to be updated on a second organization
Ticket was reassigned to an EMEA region TSE because the change had to happen during EMEA hours
TSE asked which organizations and region the change applied to, asked for one CSV per org, and confirmed the date and time
Customer supplied one CSV per org and confirmed the date and time
TSE confirmed the requestor was an admin in both orgs
TSE updated the email handles for the users in both orgs per the CSV files
Customer confirmed the change worked as expected
info_needed: Organization name and region for each org to be changed
Confirmation of the date and time of the change

qa_pairs.tse_question: Which organization name and region do these changes apply to, and can you provide one CSV file per org?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Customer provided two CSV files, one for each org, both in the EU region.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is the change to take place on the stated date at the stated time?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Customer confirmed the date and time.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is everything working as expected now that the change has been made?

tse_approach.summary: The TSE took a scheduled bulk email-handle change request, clarified scope (orgs, region, one CSV per org, timing), verified the requestor's admin status in both orgs, applied the change, and asked the customer to confirm.
steps: Introduced themself and acknowledged the request including the customer's correction
Asked for org names, region and separate CSV per org
Confirmed the date and time of the change
Verified the requestor was an admin in each org
Updated the email handles per the CSVs
Asked the customer to confirm everything worked
key_questions: Which organization name and region do these changes need to apply to, with one CSV per org?
Is the change to take place on the stated date and time?
Is everything working as expected now that the change has been actioned?
communication: Acknowledged the customer's correction up front, asked for specific missing details in one message, and reported back with the count of users updated per org and a request for confirmation.
